title: College GPA Methodology
overview: College GPA calculations are typically unweighted on a 4.0 scale, weighted by credit hours. Cumulative GPA spans all semesters, while semester GPA covers one term.

methods.name: Cumulative GPA
methods.description: Overall GPA across all completed coursework.

formula.name: Cumulative GPA
formula.expression:
Cum GPA = Total Grade Points / Total Credit Hours
Grade Points = Grade × Credit Hours per course

methods.name: Semester GPA
methods.description: GPA for a single term, used to track progress and academic standing.

formula.name: Term GPA
formula.expression: Semester GPA = Term Grade Points / Term Credit Hours

footnotes: Transfer credits may or may not factor into GPA
Dean's List typically requires 3.5+ semester GPA
